summary: Default-disabled optional bundle registry. Keep the JS core stable while isolating heavier or product-specific lanes behind explicit contracts and opt-in build steps.

bundles.summary: Default-disabled React/TS host-mounted surface bridge lane. Built assets stay grouped under content/lib/r so downstream projects can opt in without forcing React into the template core.

artifacts.summary: Host-mounted React renderer bridge for in-document surfaces loaded through loadSubScript.

bundles.summary: Planned agent runtime lane for controller/worker orchestration, scoped delegation, and compact context shaping without coupling orchestration to any single provider.
Planned JS-core service lane for provider catalogs, prompt routing, and key-governed degradation that can be reused without importing the agent runtime or React UI.

Probe-backed Wasm mini-kernel lane with checked-in content/lib/w assets plus bundle-local digest and shadow unlock derivation primitives, kept default-disabled until disabled-contract, build/export, and cost-quantification evidence are complete.

validation.summary: Keep the probe-backed Wasm lane verifiable while it remains planned: checked-in source/assets must survive build, verify, and pure-project export without promoting the lane to implemented.
